title: eludite.file.exit input
description: File > Exit (Alt+F4): quit Eludite. With unsaved changes, save says what to do with them; without it the call fails listing them (the UI asks Save, Don't Save, Cancel).

save.description: What to do with unsaved changes: save writes them first, discard drops them. Required when any of the documents is dirty: the UI asks the user (Save, Don't Save, Cancel) and passes the answer.
